units.source_text: 源氏看他从红梅树下款步入来，姿态异常优雅，

en.t: Genji watched him come walking slowly from beneath the red plum tree, his bearing exceptionally graceful,

units.source_text: 心中想道：“真能‘怜花’的人，除了此君而外更无别人了！”

en.t: and thought to himself, "There is no one but this gentleman who truly knows how to cherish flowers!"

units.source_text: 庭花含苞欲放，春色恰到好处。

en.t: The garden flowers were just about to open, and the spring scene was perfectly timed.

units.source_text: 但院内并无管弦之音，景象大非昔比。

en.t: But within the residence there was no sound of flutes or strings, and the scene was utterly unlike the past.

units.source_text: 多年来伺候紫夫人的侍女们，穿着深黑色的丧服，悲哀之情并无改变。

en.t: The women who had served Lady Murasaki for many years wore deep black mourning robes, and their grief had not changed.

units.source_text: 悼念亡人，永远无有已时。

en.t: Their mourning for the dead would never come to an end.

units.source_text: 不过源氏这一段时期绝不出门访问其他诸夫人，始终守在此地。

en.t: During this period, however, Genji never went out to visit his other ladies, but remained here throughout.

units.source_text: 侍女们得时时随侍左右，倒也聊可慰情，便殷勤地服侍他。

en.t: The gentlewomen could attend him constantly, and finding some comfort in that, they served him with devoted care.

units.source_text: 有几个侍女，过去多年来虽未受源氏主君真心宠爱，却时时蒙他青眼相看。

en.t: There were a few women who, though never truly loved by Lord Genji over the years, had from time to time received his favor.

units.source_text: 但现在源氏孤眠独寝，反而疏远她们了。

en.t: But now that Genji slept alone in solitude, he instead kept them at a distance.

units.source_text: 夜间值宿之时，无论哪个侍女，都命她们睡在离开寝台稍远之处。

en.t: When they kept night watch, he ordered every one of them to sleep a little way from his bed.

units.source_text: 有时寂寞无聊，也常常同她们闲谈旧事。

en.t: At times, when he felt lonely and idle, he would often chat with them about old days.

units.source_text: 此时俗念尽消，道心深固。

en.t: By now worldly desires had faded away, and his resolve toward the Buddhist path had grown deep and firm.

units.source_text: 然而有时也回想起：从前干了许多有头无尾之事，常使紫夫人对他怀恨，不胜后悔。

en.t: Yet at times he also remembered how, in the past, he had done so many things and left them unfinished, often making Lady Murasaki resent him, and he was overcome with regret.

units.source_text: 他想：“无论逢场作戏，或者迫不得已，

en.t: He thought, "Whether it was a passing flirtation or something I could not avoid,

units.source_text: 我为什么要做出这些事来给她看呢？

en.t: why did I have to do such things where she could see them?

units.source_text: 她对万事都思虑周至，善能洞察人心深处，然而并不无休无止地怨恨我。

en.t: She was thoughtful in all things and could see deeply into people's hearts, yet she did not resent me without end.

units.source_text: 但每逢发生事故，她总担心后果如何，多少不免伤心失意。”

en.t: But whenever anything happened, she always worried about what would follow, and could not help being hurt and dispirited."

units.source_text: 抱歉之至，后悔莫及，便觉胸中难于容纳。

en.t: His remorse and regret were so overwhelming that he felt his breast could scarcely contain them.

units.source_text: 有些侍女知道此种事情，而现在还在身边伺候，他就和她们约略谈谈。

en.t: Some of the women knew of such matters and were still serving near him, so he spoke with them about it in passing.

units.source_text: 他想起三公主初嫁过来时的情状，紫夫人当时不动声色，然而偶有感触，便觉意懒心灰，那神色十分可怜。

en.t: He remembered the time when the Third Princess first came to him in marriage; Lady Murasaki had shown no outward sign, yet when some feeling stirred in her, she seemed drained and disheartened, and her expression was deeply pitiful.

units.source_text: 就中最是落雪那天破晓，源氏娶三公主后第三日，回六条院时，暂在格子门外面伫立，觉得身上很冷。

en.t: Most of all he remembered that snowy dawn, on the third day after he had married the Third Princess, when he returned to Rokujo-in and stood for a while outside the lattice doors, feeling the cold on his body.

units.source_text: 那时天空风雪交加，气象惨烈。

en.t: At that time the sky was filled with wind and snow, and the weather was harsh and desolate.

units.source_text: 紫夫人起来迎接他，神色非常和悦，却把满是泪痕的衣袖隐藏起来，努力装出若无其事的样子。

en.t: Lady Murasaki rose to welcome him with a very gentle expression, but she hid her sleeves, which were full of tear stains, and tried hard to appear as though nothing had happened.

units.source_text: 回思至此，终夜不能成寐，痛念此种情景，不知何生何世得再相见——即使是在梦中相见？

en.t: As his thoughts returned to that scene, he could not sleep all night, aching over it and wondering in what life or world he might see her again, even if only in a dream.

units.source_text: 天色近曙，值夜侍女退回自己房中，有人叫道：“呀，雪积得很厚了！”

en.t: Near dawn, as the women on night duty withdrew to their own rooms, someone called out, "Oh, the snow has piled up so deeply!"

units.source_text: 源氏听到这话，心情完全回复到了那天破晓。

en.t: When Genji heard those words, his heart returned completely to that dawn.

units.source_text: 但身边已没有那人，寂寂独寝，悲不可言，便赋诗云：

en.t: But that person was no longer at his side; sleeping alone in silence, he was filled with unspeakable sorrow and composed this poem:
